parent_objective: train M555 L3 repair-v2 configs and select checkpoints with route-screen v2

public_gates: train all three M555 configs on seed 3540
evaluate all interval/final checkpoints as route-screen v2 candidates
use L0/L2 references with level-matched env configs
write route-screen v2 artifacts with uses_public_frozen_source_rows = false
do not run public frozen-source diagnostics unless route-screen v2 admits a candidate
forbidden_shortcuts: do not select checkpoints by public frozen-source rows
do not weaken route-screen v2 thresholds
do not drop L0 or L2 references
do not change actor input contract during training
hypothesis: At least one M555 PPO-stability L3 variant may produce an interval checkpoint that clears route-screen v2 against L0 before public diagnostics.
success_criteria: all three training runs complete with valid P0 L3 metadata
route-screen v2 evaluates all saved interval/final checkpoints with L0/L2 references
decision records whether public diagnostics are admitted or blocked
failure_criteria: training run fails or writes invalid metadata
route-screen v2 cannot evaluate multi-candidate checkpoints
no candidate clears L0 route-screen v2

commands.name: train_and_route_screen
commands.command: Train M555 configs, then run autodrift.route_screen_v2 on all interval/final checkpoints with L0/L2 references.

commands.name: route_screen_v2
commands.command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m autodrift.route_screen_v2 --episodes 64 --seed 15560 --device cpu --run-dir runs/m556_l3_repair_v2_route_screen_selection with L0/L2 references and all M556 interval/final checkpoints as candidates

decision_rule: M556 rejects public diagnostics because no L3 repair-v2 checkpoint clears route-screen v2 against L0. It does not promote a checkpoint.
